attributes.comment: I represent people that are hard of hearing in Michigan.  Visual indications work the best for most but technology that can improve speech will also help.  Visual displays should notify of any important information as well as anything that the rail driver needs to announce.  Visual displays should not display any other information such as advertisements.  It's important that we know when we see the display, the information is important.  Induction loop systems will bring the audio to my hearing aids.  It's important that any announcements made by a rail driver are of the highest quality.  This means that the microphone is of superior quality.  It also means that the microphone distance to the driver's mouth is constant, even when their heads turn.  A good quality headset will accomplish this.
